entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and I'm just not sure. The website was a lot to take in.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could you help me understand the situation a bit better? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just... I think I picked the wrong color. It looked different on my screen. The box is still unopened. I just get so overwhelmed with return policies. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you. There's no need to worry. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
Okay, I see your order for the Aero Road Helmet, delivered just last week. You are well within our 90-day return window, so processing a return for a full refund will be no problem at all.
Wait, really? It's that simple? I was so worried it would be a hassle.

It's that simple. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities, and that includes making sure you're happy with the gear you choose. In fact, since I see you're a VIP member, I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label and I'm also waiving the standard return fee for you.
Wow. That is... actually amazing. Thank you so much, Alex! You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
